admissibility_gates: scope_explicit: every pair names an explicit scope on the ainglish side (search-empty(S) / predicate-empty(S)); a bare marker aborts
search_vs_predicate: the three search-empty english arms disambiguate the search-claim reading; the three predicate-empty arms are plain scoped absence claims; a crossed pair aborts
